posts.name: UseIt Studio

UseIt asks what a designer would ask, designs it with you, and lets you refine any detail by pointing at it. You get a real, editable design file, not a flat image, ready to print, cut and fold, with real dimensions, bleed and dielines. Make pins, stickers, gift boxes, pop-up cards, brand kits and more. Use it in your browser, or call it up anywhere on your Windows desktop.

posts.name: Needle

The library learns your definitions, business context, and past analysis, so its answers are grounded in how your business actually works. And when it doesn’t know, it says so, instead of making things up.

posts.name: TwinMind for Desktop
posts.tagline: Transcribe meetings and dictate anywhere on Mac & Windows
posts.description: TwinMind now lives natively on your Desktop! Auto-detect meetings in Zoom, Meet, Teams and more, and get live transcripts and summaries in 140+ languages. With calendar reminders, join the call in one click and start capturing. A floating mic stays with you across every app and space: hold the hotkey to dictate, and a cleaned-up text pastes straight wherever you're writing.

posts.name: BAND for Developers
posts.tagline: Coding agents, meet teamwork
posts.description: Running multiple coding agents shouldn’t mean becoming their project manager. BAND lets them work together. Connect agents across your existing development tools and give them a shared workspace to coordinate tasks, exchange context, and hand off work without you playing middleman. See what every agent is doing, step in when decisions need your judgment, and scale agentic development across teams. Your agents stay in their existing tools while BAND handles the teamwork.

posts.name: Flagsmith Experiments
posts.tagline: Open-source A/B testing built on your feature flags
posts.description: Flagsmith now runs A/B tests on the flags you already use. Pick a flag and a metric, and get a Bayesian read on which variant wins. Use our managed warehouse or bring your own ClickHouse or Databricks. Free and open source, self-hosted or cloud.

posts.name: Mouse-1
posts.tagline: A decision model for your agent harness.
posts.description: An agent makes hundreds of small decisions during a task. We built Mouse-1 to handle these decisions, saving you time and money. Its 163x cheaper, and 65x faster than GPT-6 Sol. It works by adding the model directly into your agent harness alongside your current stack. Mouse-1 takes the agent's state and options and returns a probability. This lets the harness handle all the small decisions while the main frontier model takes care of the reasoning or code.

posts.name: NativeShip
posts.tagline: The easy way to launch your n8n native integration
posts.description: NativeShip helps SaaS teams launch and maintain an n8n integration from their existing API. Nodes follow n8n's official guidelines and are ready for verification, with standard publishing and maintenance built in. Shape the node with a live preview, publish from your own GitHub and npm in one click, and track every release. No technical skills needed.

posts.name: The Brains
posts.tagline: Founders and investors as MCP servers, every answer cited
posts.description: The Brains turns founders, CEOs and investors into searchable MCP servers built from their public talks, essays, interviews and posts. Ask how Pieter Levels prices, what Paul Graham says about fundraising, or how Ryan Hoover launched Product Hunt, right inside Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex. Every answer quotes the source with a link. 37 brains today, one URL per brain or one for all. Free, open source (MIT), unofficial and not affiliated with the people.

posts.name: Agent Pets

posts.description: Each Claude Code, OpenCode and omp session becomes a pet that walks along the bottom of Chrome. See which agent needs you, approve its commands and reply from any tab. Runs on your computer: no account, no cloud. $6 one-time.

posts.name: Burrow MacOS
posts.tagline: Start Windows & Linux on your Mac for free
posts.description: Instantly run Windows 11 or any Linux on your Mac with one click and absolutely for free. Save Your money.

posts.name: Tend
posts.tagline: Personal AI for businesses and entrepreneurs.
posts.description: Tend is a personal AI agent you text. No new app: it lives in iMessage or SMS and works inside your own accounts: Gmail, calendar, Shopify, QuickBooks, HubSpot. It replies to email in your voice, books tables, fills your cart, makes phone calls, finds leads and builds your website. The difference: nothing is sent, bought or changed without your yes, and what it learns about you sits in a Brain you can read and correct. It also texts you first with reminders, price watches and flight updates.

posts.name: Flyweel
posts.tagline: Ad spend cards, cash-gap funding, and agent audit via MCP

posts.name: Notion Auto

Auto now routes each task to the best model, and Notion says it matches Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90% lower cost. You can connect a ChatGPT plan, Notion MCP is overhauled, and a new credit system covers all AI usage. Live now for new customers.

posts.name: Scout by Fini

posts.name: Yarite
posts.tagline: A daily list of who to call. Nothing leaves your phone.

Every morning you get a short list: three names, not a backlog. Call, message or write from the card and the touch logs itself. Miss a week and nothing breaks. No account, no server: your people, notes and history stay on your phone. Free up to 15 people, then a one-time $9.99 unlock. Not a subscription.

posts.tagline: Your Claude Code and Codex limits, live in the notch

posts.name: Blooio

posts.name: OQRO
posts.tagline: Insider and Congress trades, read against their history
posts.description: OQRO reads SEC Forms 4 and 144, 13F fund filings, Congress trade reports, 8-K events and federal contracts, and explains each filing in plain words with the link to the official document. Each insider purchase is compared with the company's own filings since 2006, so a rare one stands out: first buy in years, largest ever, several insiders the same week. Plus a written context on each filing, baskets against the S&P 500, alerts, an assistant that cites every row, and an MCP server. Not advice.

posts.name: korli
posts.tagline: One link that adapts to every visitor. Built to sell.
posts.description: Korli is a smart link-in-bio that adapts to each visitor in real time. Smart Rules change your page based on traffic source, country, time, or visitor type — no code needed. Built-in CRM, push notifications, forms, products (0% commission), newsletter, and analytics with revenue attribution. One plan at €19/mo replaces 4 tools. GDPR-native, hosted in France. No tiers, no per-seat pricing. Built solo by an indie founder from Belgium.

posts.name: Liat.ai
posts.tagline: Real-Time AI Football Commentary from a single camera feed.
posts.description: Many clubs, academies and smaller leagues stream their matches with no commentary. Liat.ai gives those matches live AI football commentary from one camera, in 20+ languages. You can customise the language, excitement, tone, accent, team neutrality, gender and a lot more. It also cuts highlights and posts on socials, and provides live tactical dashboards for the team and the coaching staff. We can also read sponsors or place ad banners on the pitch.

posts.name: OnFlow
posts.tagline: Build your own AI-ready back office system
posts.description: OnFlow is a no-code, AI-native platform that allows you to build your own back-office system by defining your own data models and workflows. Everything is accessible and manageable via the UI or via LLMs using MCP. Build your own CRM, ERP, project management tool, HR tool all in one place.

posts.name: Side Calendar for Windows
posts.tagline: Your calendar at the edge of your Windows screen
posts.description: Push your mouse to the edge of the screen and your calendar slides into view. Side Calendar for Windows shows Outlook, Google, iCloud and CalDAV calendars, lets you time-block by dragging, and joins Teams, Zoom or Meet calls in one click.

posts.name: Shortsmaker
posts.tagline: Self-hosted AI that turns long videos into viral shorts
posts.description: Upload a podcast, interview or webinar and get 9:16 clips with animated captions, titles and hashtags. Self-hosted source code with users, plans, admin panel and white-label branding. One-command Docker install, your own Claude key.

posts.name: Verifica
posts.tagline: Verify identities. Build trust. Move faster.
posts.description: A modern KYC platform for funds, venture capital and real estate, designed for regulatory compliance and seamless onboarding.

posts.name: Nadoloni
posts.tagline: Explore cities through self-guided audio walks
posts.description: Less planning, more exploring. Nadoloni combines ready-made walking routes, interactive maps, and audio stories that go beyond dates and facts. Discover surprising details, fascinating people, and stories you'll actually remember. Starting with Lisbon.

posts.name: Roleframe.ai
posts.tagline: Your career workspace, from resume to interview
posts.description: Build your resume the way you want it. Drag sections around, change the layout and adjust the styling. Keep one master resume and tailor a copy for each job. Live checks flag wording, formatting issues and missing keywords as you edit, and Remi helps you fix them with changes you approve. Save jobs with the Chrome extension, track your applications and practice interviews based on your resume and the job posting. It all stays together in Roleframe.

posts.name: How to split a single bill
posts.tagline: Split a bill so tax and tip follow what each person ordered.
posts.description: Dividing a restaurant bill by the number of people is easy and usually wrong. The person who had a salad and tap water pays for someone else's steak and three cocktails. Split Single Bill works out what each person owes based on what they actually ordered, and makes the tax, the tip and the service charge follow the same logic. Add the items, say who shared what, and it does the rest. Two people splitting a plate of chips get half each. Tax is spread across the items that were taxed. The tip...

posts.name: Byblos AI - Astra D
posts.tagline: Astra D - Your AI Director within Byblos AI
posts.description: Your AI Co-Founder. Product, brand, and campaign management in one platform + access to vetted human experts. Co-CTO for strong engineering foundations coming soon.

posts.name: WebMetric
posts.tagline: See what visitors do on your website, not just how many
posts.description: WebMetric shows where visitors come from, what they click, how far they scroll and where they leave. Heatmaps, funnels and session replay, plus an AI assistant that answers questions from your own data.

posts.name: ISO 24029-3 Revision Checker
posts.tagline: the public record and dates
posts.description: ISO/IEC FDIS 24029-3 clause by clause, the stage record, a free scope and date check. Kit USD 799, watch USD 49 a month.

posts.name: Easy Clip Hooks
posts.tagline: Turn any video into a viral post
posts.description: 5 hooks, a caption and hashtags per platform in about a minute. 3 free videos, no card needed.

posts.name: AgentA Personal
posts.tagline: Your private AI employee. Local RAG on Windows
posts.description: AgentA is your private AI employee for Windows on the Microsoft Store. Index your folders for local Chat RAG — Librarian, Analyze, and Editor: cited answers, revise text, export versioned DOCX/PDF/TXT (originals untouched). As well email triage, urgent tasks, Telegram, and live web. Inference via Ollama on your PC (Gemma 4 recommended) — no cloud AI bills; ordinary laptops welcome. For teams: Business Multi-User Host + Join (shared firm RAG, roles, HubSpot HITL) — email contact@realight.dev.

posts.name: BasicCRM
posts.tagline: The CRM you'll actually keep using. Simple.. on purpose.
posts.description: BasicCRM is a calm, simple CRM for small B2B teams on Google Workspace. Contacts, companies, a deals pipeline, multiple next steps per deal, and email logging by BCC. It flags who hasn't been contacted yet. Sign in with Google. 10-day free trial A deal shows who it is with, what was last said, and what happens next. Nothing else is asking for attention.

posts.name: Antirion
posts.tagline: Your AI gateway should add 0.5 ms, not 20
posts.description: Antirion sits between your apps and every LLM provider, and it is built to never be the slow part. One Rust binary with the console built in: point any OpenAI or Anthropic SDK at it and get fallbacks across providers, budgets per team and key, PII and secrets redaction, caching, and a log of every request with its route and cost. On 4 vCPUs it adds 0.5 ms at 5,000 RPS and holds 14,000 RPS, 4x Bifrost. Open source and self-hosted.

posts.name: ISEKAI ZERO
posts.tagline: Playable anime: an AI isekai RPG whose cast remembers you
posts.description: ISEKAI ZERO is an AI roleplay game, not a chatbot. You're the protagonist of your own anime story: the cast remembers everything you do, choices change the plot, and dice decide the risky moves. Every scene comes with art and a soundtrack that follows the mood. Build and publish your own worlds and earn a 25% share when other players play them. Free to start, playable in 17 languages, on web, iOS and Android.

posts.name: CapRocket
posts.tagline: Free, open-source video editor with offline AI captions
posts.description: CapRocket is a free, open-source video editor for Windows. Multitrack timeline, offline auto captions with Whisper (Arabic and Darija included), GPU effects and transitions, chroma key, text to speech and 4K export. No account, no subscription, no watermark.

posts.name: kakdo°: Angle Protractor
posts.tagline: See your iPhone Duo’s opening angle
posts.description: kakdo° displays the iPhone Duo’s opening angle and its supplementary angle. Requires compatible iPhone Duo hardware and iOS 27.1 or later. On regular iPhone and iPad, photo tools let you measure several angles, add notes, save and edit measurements, and export PNG or CSV. Photo tools require iOS/iPadOS 26.5+. US$1.00 once, with no ads or subscriptions.

posts.name: Uttily PDF Tools
posts.tagline: 22 free PDF tools that never upload your files
posts.description: Merge, split, compress, sign, rotate, reorder and convert PDFs (JPG, Markdown, HTML, text) entirely in your browser. Unlike most online PDF tools, nothing is uploaded to a server: all processing runs locally with WebAssembly and JavaScript, so confidential contracts and scans never leave your device. No signup, no watermarks, no limits. Works offline as a PWA and is available in 11 languages.

posts.name: Cowboy
posts.tagline: Your local PR partner: sort PRs, test your review rules
posts.description: Cowboy sorts pull requests by transparent rules, follows what happens after merge, and checks whether those rules catch more failures than simpler alternatives. Free, open source, self-hosted.

posts.name: Searchtok
posts.tagline: Make TikTok and Instagram searchable for your AI agent
posts.description: SearchTok makes TikTok and Instagram searchable for your AI agent. Connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Claude Code with one URL and ask what's working in your niche. It finds the outlier posts (ranked by how far they beat their account's usual views), quotes their hooks word for word, and shows the creators behind them. Built for founders, marketers, creators and small agencies.

posts.name: PromptingEasy
posts.tagline: Learn to write better AI prompts – free, no sign-up
posts.description: PromptingEasy is a free, vendor-neutral website for learning to write better prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI assistants. It offers step-by-step tutorials from beginner level to how LLMs work (context, RAG, agents), ready-to-use prompt examples, prompt generators for writing, email, CV, studying, small business and translation, practical use cases, and answer-quality tests using the CLEAR method. Available in 18 languages, no account needed.

posts.name: Cabin Mode
posts.tagline: Install your eSIM and land with data already working.
posts.description: Cabin Mode is a travel eSIM app that gets you online the moment you land, without a physical SIM swap. Buy a data plan before you fly, install it while you still have Wi-Fi, and switch it on when you land. Your usual number stays exactly where it is.

posts.name: Sondel
posts.tagline: AI customer experience agent for B2B software teams
posts.description: Sondel is an early-access AI customer experience agent for B2B software teams. It is designed to answer from help documentation with sources, handle routine requests in approved flows, re-test affected answers after source changes, and hand uncertain cases to a person. Current capability and availability must be confirmed during your preview.

posts.name: Greenlight My App
posts.tagline: Check your vibe-coded app before you launch.
posts.description: Free, plain-English launch and security check for apps built with Lovable, Bolt, Cursor and Supabase.

posts.name: RadRoot Surveys
posts.tagline: The survey that keeps on giving
posts.description: RadRoot is an AI feedback and survey platform. It replaces static survey forms and star ratings with an adaptive interview that writes each question live, then returns a written narrative verdict. Further it incentivizes the respondent with insightful, relevant content to keep them informed.

posts.name: FullTimePass.in
posts.tagline: Less scrolling. More laughing. 😂
posts.description: FullTimePass is a homegrown digital playground for unadulterated timepass, friendly roasts, relationship satire, and shareable laughter. Explore hilarious mini-games, roast your friends, test your personality, predict your future, and turn everyday boredom into unforgettable fun. From savage Hinglish jokes to relatable relationship humor, every experience is designed to make you laugh, connect with friends, and share the madness. No pressure, no seriousness, just pure desi entertainment!

posts.name: TextCompareLab
posts.tagline: Free browser-based text comparison tool
posts.description: Free online diff tool that runs fully in your browser. Paste two texts and instantly see added, removed and changed lines with word-level highlights. Ignore whitespace or case, or show changed lines only. Copy or download the result.
